gate_pass.description: All three Gate conditions hold: a finite object settles it, checking a candidate terminates, and the candidate family is enumerable.

finite_witness.description: The specific finite object you would go looking for. null when gate_pass is false.

gate_reason.description: Why the Gate passed or failed, referring to the three conditions.

frontier_status.description: known ONLY if the supplied context states the boundary. Never from your own knowledge.

frontier_quote.description: Text lifted verbatim from the context establishing the boundary. null when status is unknown.

frontier_smallest_open.description: The smallest unresolved instance, as read from the quote.

frontier_search_space.description: Rough size of the search at that boundary, as read from the quote.

attention.description: Evidenced by the context and attribution, not by the problem's fame.

attention_reason.description: Cite the specific evidence in the context.

argument.description: 2-5 sentences: what object to look for, where to start, and the strongest reason this is a waste of a week.
